plugins.name: aavkar-educational-motion-studio
plugins.description: Aavkar Educational Motion Studio (AEM): records educational animation work (moments, time per stage, every tool call, render checks and evidence, approvals tied to the exact render, the client's words and rulings) and never blocks it; it asks once, before delivering a render with no current approval. Needs the aem command (cli/install.sh in this repository).
